sarkhej_roza.name: Sarkhej Roza
sarkhej_roza.hours: Open daily roughly sunrise to sunset; check on the day
sarkhej_roza.tip: Come early morning for calm light and few people. Dress modestly as parts are still in religious use.

vishwas_swaroopam.name: Vishwas Swaroopam
vishwas_swaroopam.price_text: Ticket price varies; check on the day
vishwas_swaroopam.hours: Open daily; confirm timings before you go
vishwas_swaroopam.tip: The statue is huge and outdoors. Bring water, a hat and expect a security queue.

manek_chowk_walk.name: Manek Chowk market and food street
manek_chowk_walk.price_text: Pay per dish; street snacks are cheap
manek_chowk_walk.hours: Jewellery and cloth by day · food stalls late evening into the night
manek_chowk_walk.tip: Come after dark for the food stalls. Try a local thali or a stuffed paratha.

old_city_heritage_walk.name: Old City heritage walk (pols and havelis)
old_city_heritage_walk.price_text: Guided walks usually a few hundred INR; check on the day
old_city_heritage_walk.hours: Morning walks are common; book ahead
old_city_heritage_walk.tip: A guide helps you find the narrow pol lanes and courtyard houses. Wear easy shoes.

sabarmati_riverfront.name: Sabarmati Riverfront promenade
sabarmati_riverfront.hours: Open all day; best at sunset
sabarmati_riverfront.tip: Walk the lower promenade at sunset. Some activities cost extra.

law_garden.name: Law Garden night market
law_garden.price_text: Pay per item; snacks are cheap
law_garden.hours: Evening market, roughly late afternoon to night
law_garden.tip: Good for cheap street food and local crafts in one stop. Keep small notes handy.

kankaria_lake.name: Kankaria Lake
kankaria_lake.price_text: Small entry fee; rides and the zoo cost extra
kankaria_lake.hours: Open daily; check closing time on the day
kankaria_lake.tip: A big family spot with a lakefront walk. Go in the evening when it cools down.

adalaj_stepwell.name: Adalaj Stepwell
adalaj_stepwell.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
adalaj_stepwell.tip: Carved stepwell outside the centre. Pair it with a half-day trip north of the city.

gandhi_ashram.name: Sabarmati Ashram
gandhi_ashram.hours: Open daily; confirm timings on the day
gandhi_ashram.tip: Quiet riverside site with a small museum. Allow an hour and keep it calm.

auto_rickshaw_tour.name: Auto-rickshaw city ride
auto_rickshaw_tour.price_text: Meter or agreed fare; agree the price first
auto_rickshaw_tour.tip: Agree the fare or use a meter before you set off. Short hops are cheap.

textile_shopping.name: Textile and saree shopping
textile_shopping.price_text: Pay per item; bargaining is normal
textile_shopping.hours: Shops usually open late morning to evening
textile_shopping.tip: Ahmedabad is known for textiles. Compare a few shops before buying.

gujarati_thali.name: Gujarati thali lunch
gujarati_thali.price_text: Thali prices vary; check the menu
gujarati_thali.tip: A thali is the easy way to try many local dishes at once. Come hungry.

evening_food_street.name: Evening street food crawl
evening_food_street.tip: Stick to busy stalls with high turnover. Carry water.

riverfront_viewpoint.name: Riverfront sunset viewpoint
riverfront_viewpoint.tip: Find a spot on the upper walkway for the best light over the water.

heritage_house_museum.name: Pol house heritage museum visit
heritage_house_museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
heritage_house_museum.tip: See the carved wooden facades and inner courtyards of a restored pol house.

morning_market.name: Morning vegetable and flower market
morning_market.price_text: Free to browse; buy what you like
morning_market.tip: Go early for the busiest, freshest stalls. Watch your footing in the narrow lanes.

city_museum.name: City museum and art gallery
city_museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
city_museum.hours: Closed some weekdays; confirm before you go
city_museum.tip: Good rainy-day or hot-afternoon stop. Check the closing day first.

lake_walk.name: Lakefront evening walk
lake_walk.price_text: Free to walk; rides cost extra
lake_walk.tip: Join locals for a loop of the lake. Snacks and drinks are sold nearby.

craft_bazaar.name: Local craft and textile bazaar
craft_bazaar.tip: Look for block-printed cloth and embroidery. Bargain politely.

sunset_rooftop.name: Rooftop chai stop
sunset_rooftop.tip: A rooftop chai break is a cheap way to see the old city rooftops at dusk.

half_day_tour.name: Half-day city highlights tour
half_day_tour.price_text: Tour prices vary; confirm what is included
half_day_tour.tip: Useful if you have little time. Check that entry fees and pickup are included.
